name: Llama-3.1-Nemotron-Ultra-253B-v1

lifecycle.note: Open weights still downloadable from NVIDIA's Hugging Face organisation. NVIDIA has marked only its hosted API endpoint on build.nvidia.com as deprecated (see notes); no deprecation of the model weights was found.

sources.locator: NVIDIA Post-Training Boosts Accuracy and Reliability for Enterprise Reasoning

announced.note: The GTC press release introduces the Ultra size as forthcoming; its availability section lists only Nano and Super.

summary.text: Llama-3.1-Nemotron-Ultra-253B-v1 is a 253B open-weights reasoning language model from NVIDIA, the Ultra size of the Llama Nemotron family, released in April 2025 and also offered as a hosted preview API. NVIDIA derived it from Meta's Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct with neural architecture search, distillation and continued pretraining, and says it fits on a single 8xH100 node.

features.note: Reasoning on or off is selected through the system prompt.

openWeights.note: Governed by the NVIDIA Open Model License; the Llama 3.1 Community License Agreement also applies (Built with Llama).

contextWindowTokens.note: The model overview also gives the context length as 128K tokens.

sources.locator: Get started with NVIDIA Llama Nemotron models

access.note: Hosted preview API on build.nvidia.com; NVIDIA has since marked the hosted API deprecated (deprecation date 04/22/2026), although the id is still listed in its public model list on 2026-10-02.

variants.name: Llama-3.1-Nemotron-Ultra-253B-CPT-v1
variants.note: Base checkpoint after knowledge distillation and continued pretraining, before the reasoning post-training; NVIDIA says it can be used as a base model.

notes: Announced at GTC on 2025-03-18 as the coming Ultra size and released on Hugging Face on 2025-04-07 per the model card; the GTC developer blog was updated on 2025-04-08 to cover it. On 2025-01-06 NVIDIA had announced Nano, Super and Ultra sizes without naming models; the announced date used here is the GTC press release, which first presented the reasoning Ultra model. NVIDIA describes the model as a derivative of Meta Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct built with neural architecture search, distillation and continued pretraining (cross-organisation relation, not stored here). The FP8 checkpoint nvidia/Llama-3_1-Nemotron-Ultra-253B-v1-FP8 (repository created 2025-04-30 per Hugging Face metadata) is kept as an alias. Hosted API: the build.nvidia.com page marks the endpoint nvidia/llama-3.1-nemotron-ultra-253b-v1 deprecated with the date 04/22/2026, yet the id is still in NVIDIA's public model list (integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1/models) on 2026-10-02; this concerns the hosted endpoint only, so the lifecycle follows the open weights, which remain downloadable.
